title: Install and activate
subtitle: Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins > Add Plugin. Check that it is active.

title: Add a Shortcode block
subtitle: Enter [mk_simple_live_search] in a Shortcode block, then save the page.

title: Search as you type
subtitle: Enter at least 3 characters. Use Arrow Down and Enter to open a result.

title: Choose what to search
subtitle: search_in="title" searches titles; search_in="content" searches the body.

title: Set the limit and post type
subtitle: posts_per_page="2" limits results. post_type="portfolio" searches an existing public type.

title: Independent fields and keyboard controls
subtitle: Each field keeps its own query. Escape closes results; unmatched queries show "Nothing found".
